title: Geodesic Distance & Spatial kNN
interviewAnswer: Global spatial distance should respect Earth geometry or use an appropriate projection; raw Euclidean distance on latitude/longitude can be misleading.
why: Distance choices affect clustering, nearest-neighbor features, logistics and service areas.
intuition: One degree longitude represents different distances at different latitudes.
deepDive: For regional work, a suitable projection often makes planar distance practical; global work needs geodesic formulas or libraries.
commonMistakes: Using Euclidean distance on lon/lat globally.
Ignoring road/travel-time distance when it is the real objective.
followUps: How would you accelerate spatial kNN?
production: Use the metric that matches the physical/business process.
workedExample: Choose the closest warehouse by projected/geodesic distance rather than raw degree difference.
